plugin.name: Data sources
plugin.description: PostgreSQL data sources: a direct connection, or through ssh to a container on a server. Queries run read-only.
setting.timeout.hint: A statement running longer is cancelled by the database.
setting.maxRows.hint: More rows than this are cut off and the result is marked as truncated.
field.password.hint: Written to the keychain, never to the data source itself.
note.ssh: ssh uses ~/.ssh/config and never asks for a password; the server needs docker and the container needs psql.
message.imported: Connection string imported. Save to keep it.
message.importedPassword: Imported, without the password. Type it in the password field.
message.badUrl: This is not a connection string OneDesk understands.
error.badField: The setting “{field}” is empty or not allowed (letters, digits and . _ - @ : only; no leading -).
error.severalStatements: Only one statement can run at a time.
error.noSource: No data source: pick one on the statement, in the environment, or set the default.
